user_objective: Frozen D1 small-module exploration; primary patient MacroF1 absolute gain >=0.02; inspect AUROC/AP/EZF1

candidate_definitions.M1_SCALED_DGM: Exact completed A2 architecture, with prospectively corrected FIT-only conditioning scale floor; frozen D1 + Raw CNN + multiplicative physiology gate; trainable9482
candidate_definitions.M2_STAGE_DELTA: Normalized7D window DELTA -> genuine early/late means -> across-seizure mean/popSD -> PatientZ28 -> Linear28to24 GELU Linear24to1; alpha residual; trainable722
candidate_definitions.M3_DELTA_SET: Normalized7D genuine-window DELTA -> Linear7to16 GELU Linear16to8 -> early/late means -> across-seizure mean/popSD -> PatientZ32 -> Linear32to32 GELU Linear32to1; alpha residual; trainable1354

data: No new Raw/EDF extraction. Reuse verified DGM same-window7D DELTA registry and original waveform banks, exact80/256/7635/1471965 contract. Reverify source hashes and D1 replay.
base: Original D1 selected own-fold checkpoint, R14/PatientZ/FIT imputer/scaler frozen; no D1 retraining

scale.estimator: Median of per-FIT-patient median abs DELTA, then median across patients, exactly old estimator
scale.reason: Native V-power deltas ~1e-12..1e-9 must not be collapsed by universal1e-6; floor is negligible except numerical zero, fixed before new training

pooling.PatientZ: float64 populationSD across canonical channels; <=1e-8 denominator1; input normalized to comparable units before pooling

training.loss: FIT-only original NEZ positive-class weighted BCE(final)+0.25BCE(auxiliary)
training.updates: one channel-mean update per FIT patient
training.selection: original validation patient MacroF1/EZF1/earlier; originalNEZ0:.005:1 threshold grid/ties

primary_estimand: 65 validation appearances/47 unique IDs, original5 patient-held-out folds; repeatedly used selection-conditioned Development
selection_across_candidates: One common candidate maximizing primary Development mean MacroF1 subject to target side gates; no per-fold cherry picking between architectures; all candidates/results retained

bootstrap.CI: percentile95 selection-conditioned; secondary Bonferroni3 primary-MacroF1 98.333% descriptive intervals, not correction for checkpoint/threshold/repeated-development selection

privacy: Only source/hashes/anonymous aggregate files may leave trusted server; no Raw/IDs/labels/checkpoints/private predictions/logs
